meaning:
1) a little
1a) of quantity
1b) of time
Aramaic equivalent: ze.er (זְעֵיר "little" H2192)

elsewhere.note: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
